operational-situation.description: Shows compact mapped latency and reliability signals, including the alert-feed readiness state. Values are illustrative and do not form a composite health status.

requested-operations-coverage.description: Lists required operations monitoring signals that do not yet have approved reporting contracts. Pending states do not make a live monitoring claim.

service-path-stability.description: Shows how latency moves through the service path alongside diagnostic context. Component times are not additive.

failure-surface.description: Compares illustrative failure-rate signals across operational workloads. It identifies where follow-up may be needed without implying an approved threshold or breach.

operational-control-coverage.description: Shows the readiness of reproducibility, audit, tool-use, governance, and environment controls. Pending states reflect missing approved calculation or policy rules.

safety-and-security-readiness.description: Shows which safety and security evidence is available for follow-up. The illustrative MLflow score does not imply a favorable result or approved attention threshold.
